item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena, a 13-year-old student in Pune, is making a plan for healthy growth during adolescence. Which plan is best for her?

options.A: Eat only her favourite filling snack each day, since one tasty food gives all the nutrients she needs
options.B: Eat balanced meals with proteins, carbohydrates, fats, vitamins and minerals, and play outdoor games regularly
options.C: Eat balanced meals but stop all exercise, because good food alone keeps the body healthy
options.D: Choose sweets and soft drinks instead of regular meals, and keep exercising to make up for it
